items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: we named it the Tillman and Everett band. But we was playing you know up until his death.

ctx.x: Joe Everett. Joe Everett. Oh we held that band together around about. Well I guess I might as well say up until when Joe died. Cause we broke up his band and then I made up a band and taken him in the band with me and we named it the Tillman and Everett band. But we was playing you know up until his death. He still had that band but we both was working with different bands right on. Cause I mean in this music field if you don't work with different bands you'll never make it. It's not enough night life here for…
Your band was Joe Angry was up at the buzzards club there on the enunciation or someplace?

Joe Well yeah we played for the buzzards so a lot for about it. The first club we played yeah we played for the buzzards we played for the Eleanor's. We played for the Lions and we used to play up in Audubon Park at Tyler's. You ever heard of Tyler's? Joe Oh yeah. Joe Well that's the first place I met Dick Allen. I was playing at Tyler's. Joe And I encouraged Dick to come here he was in the service thing you know. He had us to make a little cut for him. We had.
